notes.title: "Detective Agency" has officially been renamed to ‘The Eclipse Files’!
notes.content:
Hello, Detectives!
This is the official studio of ‘The Eclipse Files’!

Once known as Supernatural Detective Agency, the game has now been rebranded with a title that better fits its tone—The Eclipse Files!

The new logo and cover art are now live—come experience the allure of the All-Seeing Eye~
